title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje te rruga Mine Peza
description_sq:
Ofrojme nje apartament unik, stil penthouse per shitje.
Pozicionohet ne katin e gjashte te nje pallati ekzistues pa ashensor, organizohet ne: korridorin ne bene shperndarjen e ambienteve, tualet me dirtare, dy dhoma gjumi dhe dhoma e ndenjes sebashku me kuzhinen me dalje ne ballkon.
Apartamenti eshte me cati cka e ben te kete izolim termik akustik etj. Eshte totalisht i investuar, me kondisionere multisplit, elektroshtepiake cilesore, parket ac5,etj.
Shitet totalisht i mobiluar. Orjentimi jug perendim lindje.
Gezon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Shitet me kredi bankare!
Per cdo informacion ose nje vizit ne prone,ju lutem na kontaktoni!
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale on Mine Peza street
description_en: We offer a unique, penthouse-style apartment for sale. It is located on the sixth floor of an existing building without an elevator, it is organized in: the corridor in which the premises are distributed, a bathroom with windows, two bedrooms and a living room together with the kitchen with access to the balcony. The apartment has a floor, which makes it have thermal and acoustic insulation, etc. It is fully invested, with multisplit air conditioners, quality appliances, AC5 parquet, etc. For sale fully furnished. Orientation south west east. Gezon regular mortgage documentation. Sold with bank credit! For any information or a visit to the property, please contact us!
